data.name: Fast Food Frog
data.detailed_description:
A deliciously clumsy puzzle‑platformer!

Cururu got tired of living off insects. Now, with his backpack on and his appetite sky-high, he’s off in search of irresistible combos! Burgers, fries, sodas and more await him in levels filled with floating platforms, crazy traps, and confusion-hungry enemies.

Get ready to control this charming (and klutzy) frog in an adventure packed with flavor, strategy, and creative obstacles. Use your tongue, trigger switches, toss bombs, and uncover secrets in a world where every meal is a reward and every step demands quick thinking.

Fast Food Frog is a low‑poly puzzle‑adventure game with a top‑down camera, where you control Cururu, a cute, chubby, bipedal frog wearing a backpack with a discerning palate.

Tired of his usual insect diet, he sets out to explore the world for new flavors—juicy snacks like burgers, fries, sodas, and more. To do so, Cururu must traverse imaginative, challenging levels, complete with floating platforms, wacky switches, treacherous traps, and enemies determined to spoil his feast.

With simple controls and accessible gameplay, Fast Food Frog blends logic and precision. Each level is a puzzle that calls for experimentation, attention, and a dash of improvisation. The colorful minimalist visuals and laid-back soundtrack create a light, fun, and addictive experience for all ages.

Discover alternate routes, collect secret ingredients, and build the perfect combos to unlock new regions and tasty surprises. But be warned: the more Cururu eats… the harder it gets to stop!

🔸 Simple controls, guaranteed fun
Move Cururu with ease, use his stretchy tongue to interact with the environment, throw bombs, and use special items to overcome obstacles.

🔸 Creative switches & puzzles
Activate buttons with your tongue, step on pressure plates, manipulate objects, and find secret doors—each level is a fresh challenge for your creativity.

🔸 Happiness combo
Collect the sacred trio: burger, fries, and soda. Only then will the exit open and let Cururu advance with a happy belly!

🔸 Hilarious and unpredictable enemies
Face (or avoid!) creatures like hurried penguins, rolling tacos, bouncing jellies, and more.

🔸 Thematic worlds full of personality
Travel through uniquely styled levels, each with their own challenges and flavors:
🌿 Green fields | 🏜️ Scorching deserts | 🔥 Volcanic regions | ❄️ Icy worlds | 🐸 Viscous swamps | 🪐 Outer space | 🌊 Underwater stages | ☁️ Fast Food Heaven – the combo paradise!

✅ Vibrant low‑poly visuals overflowing with charm

Colorful stages, endearing characters, and a minimalist style that instantly captivates—with that handmade touch that gives the game personality.

✅ Accessible and surprising puzzles
Challenges that engage the mind without frustration, with creative mechanics and solutions that make you think outside the box.

✅ Light‑hearted humor, cute animations, full of charm
Cururu is pure charisma! Every step, reaction, or stumble brings a smile—perfect for anyone seeking a fun, laid-back experience.

✅ Fun for all ages
Intuitive for kids, relaxing for adults, and nostalgic for fans of platformers—Fast Food Frog appeals to all kinds of players.

✅ Perfect for quick sessions or laughter-packed marathons
Ideal for playing in your free time, between tasks, or during weekend gaming. A light game that entertains just right, with no rush and no stress.

🛎️ Help Cururu realize his dream (and ours too!)
If you’re digging the vibe of Fast Food Frog, add the game to your Steam wishlist! That helps us a ton in reaching more players and continuing to develop this deliciously crazy adventure.

🐸💚 Click the wishlist button, support an indie studio, and be among the first to know when the game launches!

🎮 Your support is our fuel (and Cururu’s snack)!
